light.why: What every pull request push runs. The light tests took 1,900 summed seconds in run 41622295122, recorded file by file in spec/test-budget-reference.json, plus 30%, raised from 15% on 2026-11-03 because runner noise and where the shards' shared setup costs land moved the same light tests between 1,902 and 2,122 summed seconds; tighten it again once about a dozen light runs show the real spread; a slow new test belongs in the heavy tier. Raised to 2,800 (1,900 plus about 47%) on 2026-11-10, after main's own light tests reached the old limit: most of the growth is a shared first-use cost (the components index build and a cold render) paid by whichever light test runs first, which marking single tests heavy only moves; making that cost cheaper is a separate change.

full.why: What a merge and the nightly run. The whole suite took 9,561 summed seconds in run 41619239254, recorded in spec/test-budget-reference.json, plus 15%; raising it is a one-way door, so the suite grows only when someone decides it should. Raised to 11,600 (9,561 plus about 21%) on 2026-11-11, after a batch's whole suite summed 11,086 s with every test passing; why test_cage_accepts grew about 107 s is a separate change. Raised to 12,400 (9,561 plus about 30%) later the same day, after the next batch's whole suite summed 11,642 s with every test passing; the three tests that grew most against its base (test_facet_render, test_rack_kit_js and test_cfp_cxp_optics) are a separate change.
